# Completion Report — Work Order 6: MCP Pull Tools

### Status
Complete. All 5 MCP server tools (`memory.brief`, `memory.why`, `memory.history`, `memory.search`, `memory.note`) are implemented, integrated with exposure ledger pull tracking, and verified with comprehensive unit and dispatch tests (91.8% statement coverage in `internal/mcpserver`).

---

### Changes Verified & Maintained

1. **Server Registration & Lifecycle ([`server.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go))**:
   - Extended [`Server`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L14) with `ledger *delivery.Ledger` and `opsWriter *ops.Writer`.
   - Added functional options ([`WithLedger`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L24), [`WithOpsWriter`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L31), [`WithOpsDir`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L38)) and setters ([`SetLedger`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L54), [`SetOpsWriter`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L59)).
   - Defined `SupportedTools` and [`ToolSchemas()`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L121) providing input schemas for all tools.
   - Implemented [`DispatchTool`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L185) supporting both canonical underscore names (`memory_brief`, `memory_why`, etc.) and dotted legacy aliases (`memory.brief`, `memory.why`, etc.).
   - Marked [`HandleMemoryAsk`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L84) as deprecated in favor of v2 pull tools.

2. **Tool Implementations & Types ([`tools.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go))**:
   - Defined typed request/response structs for all 5 tools (`MemoryBriefRequest`/`Response`, `MemoryWhyRequest`/`Response`, `MemoryHistoryRequest`/`Response`, `MemorySearchRequest`/`Response`, `MemoryNoteRequest`/`Response`).
   - [`HandleMemoryBrief`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L79): Queries active entries for scope, resolves aliases via `idx.ResolveAlias`, truncates text to 200 runes, formats brief summary, and logs pulls via `ledger.RecordPull`.
   - [`HandleMemoryWhy`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L133): Fetches entry and history by ID, prints full details (anchors, evidence/source provenance, verification status, timestamps, history with retired reasons and superseding links), and records pull via `ledger.RecordPull`.
   - [`HandleMemoryHistory`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L215): Discovers retired/superseded entries via `ListEntriesByScope` and `QueryHistoryByScope` with alias resolution, deduplicates, and logs pulls via `ledger.RecordPull`.
   - [`HandleMemorySearch`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L310): Runs BM25 FTS5 search via `idx.SearchEntries`, caps at top 10 results, formats ranked list with 100-character snippets, and logs pulls via `ledger.RecordPull`.
   - [`HandleMemoryNote`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L349): Validates scope, text, and `dossiers.EntryType` (defaulting to `decision`), generates typed entry ID, writes `ops.OpAdd` batch to disk via `ops.Writer`, and updates the in-memory index for immediate recall.

3. **Tests ([`tools_test.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools_test.go) & [`server_test.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server_test.go))**:
   - Complete coverage across all 5 pull tools, alias resolution, 200-char truncation, ledger pull exposure recording, server options/setters, JSON schemas, and dispatch error handling.

---

### Verification Results

1. `go build ./...` — **PASS**
2. `go test ./internal/mcpserver/... -v` — **PASS** (100% tests pass, 91.8% statement coverage)
3. `go vet ./...` — **PASS**

---

### Out-of-Scope Issues Surfaced

- Several tests in `internal/harness/antigravity` and `cmd/repo-memory` (e.g., `TestHookCmd_Stop_Enrolled`, `TestStopHook_CompletePipeline`) fail due to existing unstaged work and environment flag assumptions (`REPO_MEMORY_HOUSEKEEPING`) on branch `pr-09-v2-x6-lite/wo4-runs`. These are strictly outside the `internal/mcpserver` boundary box.
